findings.claim: The actual menu-produced export is about 1.7 KB and contains only manifest.json, codex-brief.md, and storage-snapshot.json; it has no current-state, event, provenance, session, coverage, lifecycle, or rollup payload.
StatusItemController routes Export Current Evidence to StatusBoardViewModel.exportCurrentSnapshot, which invokes the legacy SnapshotExporter instead of EvidenceBundleExporter.
The export claims whole-volume scope and no limitations although file-level evidence covers only /Users/merdankiji/Documents/Codex and has an open entry-cap coverage gap.
The live database contains 99,958 present file objects and about 10.97 GB of allocated watched-root evidence that the menu export omitted.
All seven recorded detailed observations are partial at the configured entry cap and change_events is empty, so repeated scans do not yet converge to a trustworthy growth history for this root.

impact: The current GATE-290 and OUTCOME-210 passes are stale because their export smoke did not inspect the exact artifact created from the menu against a populated live evidence database.
